rationale: Neither existing test covers mode tab switching or the Custom→Content→Custom roundtrip. alerts-content-templates.spec.js tests content template rendering but never toggles mode tabs. alerts-template-prebuilt-guard.spec.js tests list-level guards and basic edit/clone but never enters the mode-tab interaction path. This is a distinct feature area that warrants its own spec: alertTemplateRoundtrip.spec.js. Note: Playwright auto-discovers specs by directory (testDir: './playwright-tests'), so no manual registration needed.
